description: GeoJSON Feature for storing non-spatial system state

geometry.description: Point geometry with empty coordinates for SYSTEM features

title: SystemState

ActivityType.description: Semantic discriminator for provenance records. Consumers use this field to choose rendering or handling behaviour independently of visual tool-category grouping. Introduced by feature 208 so future entry types (manual checkpoint, standalone tune, manual rationale) can be distinguished without overloading tool-category.
ActivityType.title: ActivityType

DisplayModeEnum.description: Track visualization display mode. `full` renders the entire track regardless of current time; `trail` renders a snail-trail from track start up to current time.
DisplayModeEnum.title: DisplayModeEnum

GeoJSONEmptyPoint.description: GeoJSON Point geometry with empty coordinates (for non-spatial features)
GeoJSONEmptyPoint.title: GeoJSONEmptyPoint

InputFeatureState.description: Pre-operation state of a feature captured before a coordinate-mutating tool executes. Enables correct replay by providing the original geometry as the anchor for re-computation with modified parameters.

feature_id.description: ID of the feature whose pre-operation state is captured.

geometry.description: Full GeoJSON geometry object (type + coordinates) as it was immediately before the operation. Stored as a JSON object.

properties.description: Kind-specific spatial properties captured before the operation. Excludes provenance (which is append-only). Null if no spatial properties need capturing.

InputFeatureState.title: InputFeatureState

LogEntry.description: A PROV-aligned provenance record stored on GeoJSON features. Contains activity identity, timestamp, generator information, input/output references, execution duration, and tuning annotations.

activity_id.description: Unique operation identifier (UUID v4). Shared across features in multi-feature operations.

activity_type.description: Semantic kind of this provenance record. Optional; absent records are treated as `tool` by consumers. Introduced by feature 208 so future entry types (manual checkpoint, standalone tune, manual rationale) can be distinguished without overloading visual tool-category. See `shared/components/src/LogPanel/types.ts` `TimelineEntryKind` for the UI-side mirror.

agent.description: Human actor (e.g. analyst username) who triggered the operation. Added by #215 for Storyboarding CRUD provenance; optional and useful to any tool emitting LogEntry records.

disabled.description: Whether this entry is skipped during replay. Toggled via the flip-card edit face.

execution_duration.description: Wall-clock execution time in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT0.3S).

generated.description: Feature IDs or versioned asset paths of outputs. May be empty for in-place modifications.

generated_result_id.description: Stable logical identity for artifact-producing tools. Null for non-artifact tools.

input_state.description: Pre-operation feature states for coordinate-mutating tools. Captures geometry and spatial properties as they were immediately before the operation, enabling correct replay with modified parameters. Null for non-mutation tools.

rationale.description: Free-text analyst annotation explaining the reasoning for this operation.

timestamp.description: When the operation occurred (ISO 8601 with timezone).

tune.description: Parameter tuning record. Null until a tuning operation modifies this entry.

used.description: Feature IDs of inputs. May be empty for operations with no explicit inputs.

was_generated_by.description: Tool identity and parameters for this invocation.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry

ParameterValue.description: A typed parameter value with replay metadata.

default.description: Whether this is the default value.

tunable.description: Whether this parameter can be modified during replay.

ParameterValue.title: ParameterValue

SystemStateProperties.description: Properties for SYSTEM features storing application state

active_storyboard_id.description: Storyboard properties.id the analyst last pinned for this plot (#237)

current_time.description: Playhead position at save (ISO-8601). When present, must lie within [start_time, end_time] (enforced by the load validator, not the schema).

display_mode.description: Track visualization mode for this plot.

end_time.description: Analytical window end (ISO8601) - for temporal state

filter_end_time.description: Visible-window filter end (ISO-8601). Absent = unbounded end.

filter_start_time.description: Visible-window filter start (ISO-8601). Absent = unbounded start.

playback_rate.description: Playback speed multiplier for this plot (0.1-100).

provenance.description: PROV-aligned provenance records (append-only log of tool operations)

selected_ids.description: Array of selected feature IDs - for selection state

selected_primary.description: Primary selection path for properties display.

start_time.description: Analytical window start (ISO8601) - for temporal state

state_type.description: Discriminator for state variant (temporal, spatial, selection, active_storyboard)

step_size.description: Playback step granularity for this plot.

viewport.description: Saved map viewport (ViewportPolygon). Identity-mapped to SpatialSlice.viewport.

SystemStateProperties.title: SystemStateProperties

TimeStep.description: Step size for discrete time navigation (FR-008)
TimeStep.title: TimeStep

TuneAnnotation.description: Records a parameter modification (appended, not replacing original).

parameter.description: Name of the parameter that was changed.

timestamp.description: When the tuning occurred (ISO 8601 with timezone).

TuneAnnotation.title: TuneAnnotation

ViewportPolygon.description: Geographic area as a 4-corner polygon supporting rotated views (FR-012, FR-013)

coordinates.description: Four corners in clockwise order [NW, NE, SE, SW]

zoom.description: Map zoom level for restoring the view (optional)

ViewportPolygon.title: ViewportPolygon

WasGeneratedBy.description: Identifies the tool and its parameters for a specific invocation. Named after the W3C PROV vocabulary term.

parameters.description: Full resolved parameter set. Keys are parameter names, values are ParameterValue objects. May be empty dict.

WasGeneratedBy.title: WasGeneratedBy
